questions.question: Divide negative two-thirds by one-sixth. Written in symbols this is (−2/3) ÷ (1/6). What is the quotient in simplest form?
questions.explain: Dividing by 1/6 means multiplying by its reciprocal 6/1: (−2/3) × 6 = −12/3 = −4. Multiplying straight across without flipping gives −1/9, and a negative divided by a positive stays negative.

questions.question: Simplify (3/8) ÷ (−3/4). Give the answer in lowest terms.
questions.explain: Keep 3/8, flip −3/4 to −4/3, and multiply: (3/8) × (−4/3) = −12/24 = −1/2. Multiplying straight across without flipping gives −9/32, and the answer is negative because a positive divided by a negative is negative.

questions.question: Multiply negative four-fifths by negative five-eighths. In symbols: (−4/5) × (−5/8). What is the product in simplest form?
questions.explain: Multiply numerators and denominators: (−4)(−5) = 20 and 5 × 8 = 40, so the product is 20/40 = 1/2, positive because two negatives multiply to a positive. There is no flipping when multiplying; flipping belongs to division.

questions.question: Simplify (−7/10) ÷ (−7/5). Give the answer in lowest terms.
questions.explain: Multiply by the reciprocal of the divisor: (−7/10) × (−5/7) = 35/70 = 1/2, and a negative divided by a negative is positive. Multiplying without flipping gives 49/50.

questions.question: Simplify (−3/4) ÷ (9/8). Give the answer in lowest terms.
questions.explain: Flip the divisor 9/8 to 8/9 and multiply: (−3/4) × (8/9) = −24/36 = −2/3. Multiplying straight across gives −27/32, and flipping the −3/4 instead of the divisor gives −3/2.

questions.question: During a dry spell in Kamloops, a pond's water level changes by −1/3 m each week. Its total change so far is −5/6 m. How many weeks has the dry spell lasted? Compute (−5/6) ÷ (−1/3).
questions.explain: Total change divided by change per week gives the number of weeks: (−5/6) ÷ (−1/3) = (−5/6) × (−3/1) = 15/6 = 5/2 weeks, a positive count because a negative divided by a negative is positive. Multiplying by −1/3 without flipping gives 5/18.

questions.question: Use the order of operations to simplify (−1/2 + (−1/4)) ÷ (3/8). Work out the brackets first.
questions.explain: Inside the brackets, −1/2 + (−1/4) = −3/4; adding two negatives keeps the sign negative, since ‘two negatives make a positive’ is a multiplication rule, not an addition rule. Then (−3/4) ÷ (3/8) = (−3/4) × (8/3) = −2.

questions.question: A reservoir near Kelowna is being drained. Its water level changes by −2/5 m every week. What is the change in level after 3/4 of a week?
questions.explain: Multiply the rate by the time: (−2/5) × (3/4) = −6/20 = −3/10 m, and the result stays negative because the level is still going down. Dividing by 3/4 instead of multiplying gives the wrong −8/15.

questions.question: Kai simplifies (−4/9) ÷ (2/3) by multiplying straight across and gets −8/27. What went wrong?
options: He never flipped the divisor 2/3 to 3/2; the answer is −2/3
He flipped the wrong one: (−9/4) × (2/3) gives −3/2
Nothing is wrong; you divide fractions by multiplying across
Only the sign is wrong; negative over positive gives 8/27
questions.explain: To divide by 2/3, multiply by its reciprocal 3/2: (−4/9) × (3/2) = −12/18 = −2/3. Multiplying straight across without flipping is the most common slip, and the sign stays negative because a negative divided by a positive is negative.

questions.question: A walk-in freezer at a Surrey grocery store cools at a steady rate. Over 5/6 of an hour its temperature changed by −5/4 °C. If the rate stays the same, what is the temperature change during just 1/2 hour?
questions.explain: First find the change per hour: (−5/4) ÷ (5/6) = (−5/4) × (6/5) = −3/2 °C per hour, then multiply by 1/2 to get −3/4 °C. Multiplying by 5/6 without flipping gives −25/24 per hour and the wrong −25/48.

questions.question: A hiker on Grouse Mountain descends steadily. Her elevation changes by −3/8 km, then by another −1/8 km, and the whole descent takes 3/4 of an hour. What is her elevation change per hour?
questions.explain: Add the two changes first: −3/8 + (−1/8) = −1/2 km (two negatives added stay negative), then divide by the time: (−1/2) ÷ (3/4) = (−1/2) × (4/3) = −2/3 km/h. Treating the two negatives as a positive 1/2 gives 2/3, the wrong sign for a descent.

questions.question: Liam divides (−5/6) ÷ (10/3). He writes (−6/5) × (10/3) and gets −4. What went wrong?
options: He should not flip at all; (−5/6) × (10/3) = −25/9 is right
He only got the sign wrong; the correct answer should be 4
Nothing; you flip the first fraction and multiply, so −4 is right
He flipped the dividend; flipping 10/3 to 3/10 gives −1/4
questions.explain: When dividing, keep the first fraction and multiply by the reciprocal of the divisor: (−5/6) × (3/10) = −15/60 = −1/4. Flipping the dividend instead of the divisor changes the value of the expression.
